# Verification catalogue {#sec-ch15}

Run the two-rank test selections serially (`ctest -j1`): their launchers can share rendezvous port 29500.
Concurrent independent launches need distinct free ports set in each launcher's `--master-port` argument;
`ctest -j` alone does not assign ports ({{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}}).
